issuer.scope: Issuer-wide organizational, disclosure and operating judgment; canonical Ethereum is the dashboard's phase-one market and authority scope.
issuer.summary: Frax has a multi-year operating record, public governance, maintained documentation, a machine-readable frxUSD balance sheet and named third-party audits. FIP-432 delegates compliance and collateral management to Frax Inc while the Frax DAO retains ultimate control. The score remains 5.0 because operational disclosure is incomplete where it matters most: no authorizing record was located for the August 2026 zero-overlap admin migration, signer custody and independence are not publicly established, and live cross-chain deployment growth has outpaced the accepted authority walk.
facts: Frax Facts reported $108.457m of frxUSD assets and $105.479m of circulating liabilities at 2026-10-11T16:03:47Z.
The reported reserve was concentrated in WTGXX at 62.22%, followed by USTB at 21.32%, BUIDL at 14.61% and a segregated Erebor Bank reserve account at 1.85%.
FIP-432 delegates issuer-level compliance and collateral management to Frax Inc while the Frax DAO retains ultimate control and can amend or revoke the delegation.
Zellic published a July 2025 Frax review covering the original frxUSD and custodian system and a February 2026 review covering newer frxUSD infrastructure and cross-chain components.
The Ethereum owner changed in August 2026 from a 3-of-5 Safe to a 4-of-7 Safe with no signer overlap; the reviewed assessment did not locate the governance record authorizing that handover.
Frax now reports frxUSD supply across more than 30 networks, while the accepted authority evidence covers only a subset; unwalked deployments are unmeasured rather than clean.
Contract powers, delay enforcement and audited-code deployment identity are priced on Contract & Admin rather than counted again on Issuer.
issuer.summary_source: riskAnalyst frxUSD whole-body assessment verified 2026-10-12; Frax Facts balance sheet and summary APIs observed 2026-10-11; Frax documentation and Zellic publications; accepted authority walk for the bounded admin-history facts.
